empty srcset without src selects null and sets currentSrc to empty string
ascending x descriptors: selects candidate matching devicePixelRatio
ascending x descriptors without exact match: selects first candidate above devicePixelRatio
x descriptors straddling devicePixelRatio: selects the higher density even when the lower one is closer
descending x descriptors: sorts ascending before selecting
unsorted x descriptors: sorts ascending and picks smallest density >= devicePixelRatio
non-adjacent duplicate x descriptors: keeps earliest entry
all x descriptors below devicePixelRatio: selects highest density
unsorted x descriptors all below devicePixelRatio with duplicate max: sorts and keeps earliest max
w descriptors with sizes: normalizes densities, sorts ascending, and selects first >= devicePixelRatio
w descriptors all below devicePixelRatio: selects highest normalized density
w descriptors with sizes=0px: infinite densities deduplicate keeping earliest
src with srcset 1x candidate: src is omitted in favor of srcset 1x entry
src with lower-density srcset candidate: src joins source set as 1x
src with higher-density srcset candidate: selects between 1x src and higher srcset density based on devicePixelRatio
picture source element uses the same density selection algorithm
cached lower-density candidate is never preferred over candidate >= devicePixelRatio
CSS zoom on the img element itself does not scale x-descriptor target density
CSS zoom on an ancestor element does not scale x-descriptor target density
0x candidate is not selected when a candidate >= devicePixelRatio exists
sole 0x descriptor is selected as last candidate when below devicePixelRatio
cached mid-density candidate never causes selection of higher uncached candidate
shadowing replaceable window.devicePixelRatio does not affect image source selection
w descriptors with sizes=0px (wider first): both normalize to Infinity and earliest wins deduplication
w descriptors with media conditions in sizes: normalizes using first matching source size
srcset with only invalid descriptors falls back to src as 1x default source
explicit 1x descriptor before bare URL (default 1x): earliest 1x wins deduplication
cached duplicate higher-density candidate is removed by deduplication before cache check
cached duplicate candidate at same density does not override earlier uncached candidate
cached src attribute is excluded from source set when srcset already has a 1x descriptor
picture skips non-matching/unsupported/empty-source-set sources and normalizes/deduplicates w descriptors on matching source
dynamically updating srcset re-runs image source selection
dynamically increasing sizes re-normalizes w descriptors and selects higher-width candidate
